sampling_rule: For each P4.07 relevance_status, select min(requested, available) distinct article IDs using random.Random(random_seed).sample, then shuffle the combined sample with the same seeded generator. Article title/content are joined from the authoritative source CSV by article_id. Predicted status and topic labels are not included in the reviewer CSV.
limitations: Sampling strata are based on P4.07 rule-based predictions, not gold labels.
The review sample is an audit sample, not a representative sample of natural class distribution.
This sample cannot establish corpus-wide prevalence or unbiased performance metrics without an appropriate sampling design and reliable reference labels.
Do not calculate Accuracy, Precision, Recall, or F1 without a trustworthy adjudicated gold set.
